title: SBS meeting schedule: Tue 15/Sep moved +3h
summary: The time of next week's Small Business meeting has been pushed forward by 3 hours.
content:
We've moved next week's Small Business Zoom session forward 3 hours.

This is the slot we designed to suit Decimals in the Americas, but at 15:00 the scheduled time doesn't suit those on the west coast who are still at work.

This session only has been moved to:

  • 18:00 Mon 14/Sep – Los Angeles (UTC-7)
  • 21:00 Mon 14/Sep – New York (UTC-4)
  • 01:00 Tue 15/Sep – UTC
  • 10:00 Tue 15/Sep – Tokyo (UTC+9)
  • 11:00 Tue 15/Sep – Canberra (UTC+10)
  • 13:00 Tue 15/Sep – Wellington (UTC+12)
  • View a timezone chart

Your calendar should update

If you're subscribed to the events calendar (Business members only) this slot should have updated in your calendar.

If it hasn't:

  1. Refresh the subscription.
  2. Confirm you're subscribed to the calendar and that you didn't import a point-in-time copy instead.

Feedback welcome

We try to pick times that suit the most people. Let us know if this doesn't suit, and what does. We'll keep experimenting.
